description: This file defines an enumeration for different share period frequency types used within the Fineract project. It provides mappings between integer codes, string codes, and enum constants, along with utility methods for conversion and validation.

classes.name: SharePeriodFrequencyType
classes.description: An enum representing different supported calendar periods (days, weeks, months, years) for share products, including utility methods for conversion and validation.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the integer value associated with the enum constant.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the string code associated with the enum constant.

methods.name: fromInt
methods.description: Converts an integer to the corresponding SharePeriodFrequencyType enum, defaulting to INVALID for null or unrecognized values.

methods.name: isInvalid
methods.description: Checks if the current enum instance is INVALID.

methods.name: integerValues
methods.description: Returns an array of integer values for all valid enum constants (excluding INVALID).
